purpose: Forward (live) test of the only family that survived the 2013-2026 search placebo. Nothing below may be changed after this date; results are judged on weeks after 2026-11-30 only.
signal: running share of the Americas smelters (CL-CHUQUI, CL-CALETONES, PE-ILO; CD-KAMOA from 2025-12-29), S-NPP-only index of scripts/activity_index_snpp_2012_2026.py (56-day window, seasonal reference, cut 0.6, min_ref 0.3, carry 4 weeks), defined when known capacity >= 50 % of the region
transform: 8-week change divided by the standard deviation of past 8-week changes (52 weeks, min 26, lagged one week), then 4-week moving average
position: sign of the transformed signal, averaged over the last 8 weeks (hold 8), traded on the Monday 8 days after the satellite week ends
instrument: equal-weight basket of Furukawa Electric 5801.T, Sumitomo Electric 5802.T, Fujikura 5803.T, each minus the Nikkei 225, weekly Monday-to-Monday returns
sizing: 10 % annual volatility target on past 26-week volatility, |weight| <= 1
costs: 4 bp per unit of turnover (two legs)
success_criterion: after 104 forward weeks: Sharpe > 0.5 and more than half of the new 8-week positions gaining (about 4 to 5 are expected); anything else counts as a failure
